title: H100 allocated for two serial candidate arms; setup and correctness gates first
change: Pod registered in US-MO-1 at 3.99/hour under a 3 dollar segment. 50 MB payload uploading; arm A runs runtime, ratio-1 resume and first-block parity gates before training, arm B runtime and resume gates.
result: First segment 2699 s (2.99 dollars); whole plan about 3294 s (3.65 dollars) with one automatic renewal. No scientific training or evaluation completed yet.

steps.task: H100 allocated for two serial candidate arms; setup and correctness gates first

decision.reviewing: How to run the two candidate arms when no two-GPU H100 pod is offered?
options: One H100, both arms serial in separate supervisor loops (about 3200 s, 3.55 dollars, one lease renewal)
Wait for a two-GPU H100 offer
evidence: 52 regions quoted: ten single-H100 offers at 3.99/h (low stock), zero two-GPU H100 offers under the 10/h ceiling.
Arm A first-block parity needs the baseline runtime (H100, cu128); other GPU types have no throughput or parity evidence.
Exact-job storage gate passed for the two-arm bounds: 7.87 GB required, 17.47 GB free.
decision.reason: Serial on the validated GPU type keeps both hypotheses honest and starts now; waiting has no release signal and cheaper GPUs would void the parity gate.
decision.next_action: Launch through the guarded launcher; publish per-job progress; helpers continue seed audit and export readiness.

details.title: Arm A admitted: CB2048 chain on the H100 (supervisor loop loop-a)
details.change: Pod nufncmbfvuz9s1 registered at 3.99/hour; payload setup under the shared deadline. Gates: runtime, ratio-1 resume, frozen first-block reference, candidate parity before first update.
details.result: Then CB2048 training (2048 games) and six frozen bouts (Baseline2048 and CB2048 vs E1024, F1024, OwnInitial). Lease renews automatically while progress is observable.

details.title: Arm B admitted: D99_2048 chain on the same H100 (supervisor loop loop-b)
details.change: No two-GPU H100 offer existed, so arm B shares the device serially: runtime and ratio-1 resume gates, D99_2048 training, three frozen bouts paired to the baseline seeds.
details.result: Expected whole plan about 3294 s for both arms. Readout uses the discount-tolerant paired audit prepared in session 28.

details.title: Helper: seed-collision audit and independent-seed replication package
details.change: Claude helper audits the proposed confirmation/development seed ranges against the immutable archive and prepares a validated replication job list for a free device.
details.result: Deliverable: audit JSON plus validated jobs in an isolated workspace; coordinator verifies before any admission.

details.title: Helper: export environment and ladder readiness
details.change: Claude helper locates or builds an isolated environment with the onnx module, dry-runs the MuZero export on archived Baseline2048 weights, and computes ladder standings with the real roster.
details.result: Deliverable: tested export command, parity fixture, standings JSON; no public asset or roster change.
